title: Lesotho CMS — FSD knowledge graph (screenshot SoT)

nodes.label: Lesotho CMS
nodes.summary: Newer Admin + Student CMS for Limkokwing Lesotho (limkokwing.ac.ls). Reverse-engineered from Faid’s 3 Oct 2026 screenshots. No MySQL dump yet — UI/capability graph only. Old LUCT-family CMS dump pending (Vara; family tree ≈ Botswana / Cyberjaya).
nodes.raisd: M4 pilot acceptance campus (WG 3 Oct 2026). Feature benchmark for Raisd portals; CAP-53 Live SoR path TBC after old dump.

nodes.label: Admissions
nodes.summary: Review queues, applicants, document review (LGCSE), payments in Loti, intake settings and certificate types.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.summary: Student master (~22k), registration, graduations, clearance, status, remarks, referrals, notes.

nodes.label: Faculty / curriculum
nodes.summary: Schools → programs, modules, assessment types, attendance, timetable generator / venues. FiveDays LMS linked as separate product.

nodes.label: Commercial
nodes.summary: Pricing desks: repeat modules, fees and fines, payment plans. Admissions payments in M (Loti).

nodes.label: Student portal
nodes.summary: Dark card-grid home: Registration, Curriculum, Finance, Assessments, Timetable, Results.

nodes.label: Admin / platform
nodes.summary: Users, Positions (RBAC), calendars, notifications (templates / events / broadcast), activity tracker, settings.

nodes.label: Admissions Review
nodes.summary: Intake Jan 2026 sample: rank + score, progress 0/3–1/3, analytics Pending / Recommended / Not Recommended; by-school bars (FBMG, FICT, FABE, FCM, FFLD). Detail: Academic → QA → Registrar.

nodes.label: Document Review
nodes.summary: High-volume LGCSE scan + extract (subjects incl. Sesotho, institution, certificate number). Queue ~3945 in sample.

nodes.label: Admissions Payments
nodes.summary: Application payment VERIFIED in M (Loti). Intake periods and certificate types under Admissions Settings.

nodes.label: Registry · Students
nodes.summary: Master–detail student list with search. Tabs: Academics, Student, Registration, Attendance, Card, Graduation, Finance, Sponsors, Education.

nodes.label: Academics / SoR print
nodes.summary: Term blocks with Code / Name / Status / Cr / Mk / Gd; GPA + CGPA; Drop vs Compulsory. Print Statement of Results (signature + stamp) and Programme Summary with outstanding repeats + QR. Registrar stamp: LUCT Lesotho.

nodes.label: Student Card
nodes.summary: Photo upload / camera capture; Preview + History; physical card preview branded LUCT LESOTHO / Lesotho Campus return text.

nodes.label: NMDS sponsors
nodes.summary: National Manpower Development Secretariat sponsorship: borrower number, term tags (e.g. 2026-07 …), Sponsors / Semesters sub-tabs. Lesotho government analogue to Botswana DTEF (different agency).

nodes.label: Graduation Clearance
nodes.summary: Large clearance queue (~549). Wizard steps (e.g. Ceremony); Academic / Finance clearance; Approve/Reject + message (e.g. gown / graduation fee). Also Requests, Dates, Certificate Reprints.

nodes.label: Remark Requests
nodes.summary: Re-assessment review queue (badge in sample).

nodes.label: Curriculum
nodes.summary: Schools → programs (e.g. FICT: CBIT, BSCSM, BSCBIT, BSCIT, DMSE, DBIT, DIT).
nodes.raisd: Programme structures for portal academic context.

nodes.label: Timetable
nodes.summary: Generator, Allocations, Venues, Venue Types; Assessment Types; Attendance.

nodes.label: Pricing
nodes.summary: Repeat Modules, Fees and Fines, Payment Plans.

nodes.label: Student · Registration
nodes.summary: Enrolled-term history list (e.g. Aug 2023 → Feb 2026) with Active status; FAB for new registration request.

nodes.label: Student · Results
nodes.summary: View / download academic results from student portal card grid (alongside Curriculum, Finance, Assessments, Timetable).
nodes.raisd: Student Demo depth → Live parity target.

nodes.label: FiveDays LMS
nodes.summary: Sidebar link to FiveDays Learning Management System — separate product label, not Raisd Live LMS.
nodes.raisd: LMS research / CAP-44 family — external; do not treat as Raisd Live.

nodes.label: Positions / RBAC
nodes.summary: ~23 positions (Library HOD, Registrar, Registry HOD, Faculty Manager, Program Leader, Marketing Staff, …). Permissions Read/Create/Update/Delete per module (Appraisals, Registry, Admin, Library, …).
nodes.raisd: Shared platform RBAC model for staff portal.

nodes.label: Student master
nodes.summary: Conceptual shared student record hub observed via Registry UI (not a named MySQL table until dump). Admissions enrol into it; academics, card, NMDS, finance and graduation attach.
nodes.raisd: Identity / enrolment source for campus-keyed Portal API once SoR path is agreed.

nodes.label: Portal API
nodes.summary: Raisd anti-corruption layer. Live Lesotho SoR adapter pending old CMS dump + WG decision (adapter vs Schema v3 cutover).
nodes.raisd: CAP-53 campus-keyed ACL — M4 critical path.
